span.p:
domainpack.py + voiceprompts.py
the two config loaders

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the dependency rule, in one line:
domain knows nothing - ports know domain -
services know domain and ports - adapters know
ports and a vendor. Any file that breaks that is a bug.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
why config/ is separate and large. Every insurance
literal lives there, so retargeting this to a hospital
line or a telco desk means swapping YAML, not touching
services/. That reuse claim is D28, and it is enforced:
no insurance literal may be hardcoded in services/ —
and since P3, no prompt id either.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
a gitignore lesson worth keeping (B9). A bare
directory name matches at ANY depth, so `models/` for ML
weights silently swallowed src/readycall/db/models/ and a
whole phase shipped with no ORM package. It is anchored
`/models/` now. After adding a package: git ls-files it.
